summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share repurchases under its existing buyback program announced on May 20, 2025. From May 4-8, 2026, it bought 2,760 ordinary shares at an average price of €23.50 and 606,814 ADS-equivalent shares at a volume-weighted average price of ~$28.40. All purchased shares are cancelled. No board recommendation or advisors are disclosed. The program is ongoing with weekly updates. Watch for continued capital return execution; no arbitrage angle as it's a vanilla buyback.
